CODEC-111.label: I
CODEC-111.reason: This is about `URLCodec.ESCAPE_CHAR` being non-final, a constant/immutability issue in a different codec class and a different encoding scheme. It shares only the broad `org.apache.commons.codec.net` package, but not the quoted-printable soft line break decoding mechanism.

CODEC-114.label: I
CODEC-114.reason: This concerns `Soundex.US_ENGLISH_MAPPING` visibility in the `language` subsystem, driven by FindBugs packaging/encapsulation concerns. It has no functional overlap with quoted-printable decoding or line-break handling.

CODEC-113.label: I
CODEC-113.reason: Same as CODEC-114, but for `RefinedSoundex.US_ENGLISH_MAPPING`. This is a separate phonetic encoding module and an access-modifier issue, so it provides no meaningful localization signal for quoted-printable soft line break decoding.
